name: golang-design-patterns
description: Idiomatic Golang design patterns — functional options, constructor APIs, `init()` and global-state avoidance, enums, panic vs error decisions, resource management and lifecycle, graceful shutdown, timeouts and retries, streaming and iterators, and architecture styles (clean, hexagonal, DDD, flat). Apply when choosing between architectural patterns, implementing functional options, designing constructor APIs, setting up graceful shutdown, applying resilience patterns, or asking which idiomatic Go
author: samber
summary_zh: 一套面向 Go 的惯用设计模式指南，帮助你在架构选型、API 设计、资源管理、容错和优雅停机等场景中写出稳健代码。
